Exploring how complex systems learn, adapt, and evolve. Technology is not the objective. Business value is. I help organizations understand business problems, simplify processes, and make better use of existing tools before recommending new technology. When a genuine gap remains, I enjoy designing and building high-quality software, automation, and AI-supported products that reduce complexity and create measurable value.

I help organizations solve business problems by combining operational excellence, technology strategy, automation, and AI. My focus is not on adopting technology for its own sake, but on identifying practical solutions that create measurable value. Throughout my career, I have learned that many organizations can unlock significant improvements by simplifying processes, eliminating unnecessary work, and making better use of the tools they already own. Before recommending new technology, I focus on understanding the underlying problem and its root causes. When a genuine gap exists, I enjoy designing and building software products that improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and support business growth. My approach is simple: understand the problem, choose the right solution, and build only what truly needs to be built. I am a multidisciplinary engineer and product builder whose career has been shaped by a fascination with complex systems and the ways they learn, adapt, and evolve. My experience spans financial services, medical devices, manufacturing, and information systems. The common thread is understanding how people, processes, technology, and information work together, rather than starting with a particular industry or tool.

I am a husband and father of three children. Originally from Costa Rica, we relocated to the United States in 2018 to pursue opportunities in the design and development. The transition provided professional growth, but it also required rebuilding many aspects of daily life from the ground up, from establishing new networks, securing credit and navigating unfamiliar systems to creating a new sense of home. The experience strengthened my appreciation for adaptation, resilience, and lifelong learning. Throughout my career, I have worked with global organizations, traveled internationally, collaborated across cultures, and participated in conferences spanning multiple disciplines. One of my earliest international experiences was representing Costa Rica through sponsorship from the Ministry of Science and Technology to participate in activities associated with the Texas Symposium on Relativistic Astrophysics at Stanford University. My academic foundation combines a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering with a Master of Science in Information Management from the University of Washington, completed with a 4.0 GPA. More recently, I completed Codecademy's Full-Stack Engineer and AI Engineer career paths as part of a deliberate expansion into modern software development and artificial intelligence. I am particularly drawn to problems requiring systems thinking, pattern recognition, problem decomposition, technical adaptability, strategic planning, analytical rigor, and cross-domain problem solving. Rather than viewing disciplines in isolation, I enjoy understanding how people, technology, processes, and information interact to produce measurable outcomes. Like many technically minded professionals, I continue improving my ability to balance depth with speed. My tendency toward deep analysis, taking on ambitious challenges, and pursuing multiple initiatives simultaneously can be both a strength and an opportunity for growth. Whether the system is a software platform, an AI model, a business process, an organization, my community, or a human career, that curiosity informs how I work. The practical test is always the same: does the solution address a real need, and is it worth building? Understand the business need and root causes before choosing technology.
